name: Swastika Jha
bio: A writer from Patna whose soft corners hold sharp truths. She has completed her master’s in biotechnology and writes intimate, reflective pieces for The Untold Phrase that stay with the reader.

name: Divyesh Prajapati
bio: Ahmedabad-based writer known for microtales about love, almosts, and the quiet turns that change everything.

name: Adity Sinha
bio: An IT engineer from Bangalore who pens unfinished poetry — unfinished only in the sense that feeling never really ends.

name: Sakshi Shukla
bio: From Prayagraj, Sakshi writes with warmth and clarity — stories that feel like conversations you were meant to overhear.

name: Palak Jatwani
bio: Author of Her Graceful Melancholy (2021). Palak’s poems hold body, ache, and grace in the same breath.

name: Harshita Purohit
bio: Harshita writes soft, honest lines — the kind you screenshot and send to someone at midnight.

name: Srilekha Mitra
bio: A voice from Kolkata, studying at Calcutta University, weaving everyday life into verse.

name: Neha Dhalaria
bio: A lawyer by profession and a writer by instinct — Neha’s pieces cut clean and land true.

name: Tanya Vatsa
bio: Dental surgery by day, unheard stories by night — Tanya writes the things people keep behind polite smiles.

name: Divya Pyarani
bio: From Solapur, Divya brings grounded storytelling — small towns, big feelings.

name: Suhana Patwa
bio: Suhana writes from Banasthali with a gentle, persistent voice — journals turned into shared pages.

name: Vatsal Vishwam
bio: Writing since the age of nine from Ranchi — Vatsal’s work carries the long patience of someone who never stopped.

name: Meenal Rajpoot
bio: Faridabad-based writer whose musings turn ordinary evenings into something worth keeping.

name: Vrunda Prajapati
bio: Ahmedabad’s quiet chronicler — Vrunda shares thoughts that feel handwritten, even on a screen.

name: Navjot Singh
bio: From Punjab — writing where reason and feeling sit at the same table.

name: Jahnavi Morge
bio: Between Neral and Mumbai, Jahnavi writes the in-between spaces — commute, memory, and becoming.

name: Sanskriti Bhatt
bio: Selected writer for The Untold Phrase — remembered for committed craft and a firm stand for the community.

name: Riya Vijay Chandani
bio: A select voice of The Untold Phrase — part of the TUP family of writers.

name: Atir Rizvi
bio: A select writer for The Untold Phrase, contributing to the page’s growing library of original work.
